content: {"summary":"Battery drain spikes after iOS 11 updates are a widespread issue, with users reporting 40‑50% drops in just ten minutes. The problem persists even in low‑power mode and after device resets, indicating a software‑level fault. Users on iPhone 7, SE, and iPad all report similar rapid depletion, suggesting a systemic bug across devices. Immediate investigation and a patch are urgently needed to restore battery life.\n\n[#tk_2693996] [#tk_2572074] [#tk_332468] [#tk_1061493]"}
